events.title: Swiss {ai} Weeks 2026
events.blurb: Nationwide umbrella series of AI hackathons and executive dinners running through early October.

events.title: ETH AI Center Researchers Community Meetup
events.blurb: Recurring meetup series for the AI research community at ETH Zurich.

events.title: Zurich AI Festival 2026
events.organiser: ETH AI Center / Greater Zurich Area
events.blurb: Week-long umbrella festival — 40+ AI events across enterprise, science, and policy.

events.title: Hack am Rhein 2026
events.blurb: Four-day interdisciplinary hackathon for the Basel region with challenges from pharma, high-tech manufacturing, architecture and social impact, closing with Sunday demos on the FHNW campus.

events.title: Hack Apertus
events.blurb: Two-week online hackathon building on Switzerland's open Apertus LLM, with red-teaming and Swiss-language localisation tracks; on-site legs follow in six Swiss cities through to the May 2027 finals.

events.title: Panoramai Summit Lausanne 2026 – Enterprises & People / Reasoning & Creative AI
events.blurb: Conference on enterprise GenAI strategy and agentic AI.

events.title: AI in Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity in AI
events.blurb: A lunchtime seminar with Finnish cybersecurity companies on building AI into security products, and on what startups and enterprises in critical sectors should weigh up before adopting AI-driven practices.

events.title: What Survived the Portfolio Review: AI in Life Sciences That Held Up
events.blurb: Four talks on why AI in life sciences is full of pilots and short on production deployments — what separates the projects that made it past proof-of-concept, and the regulatory requirements now shaping them — followed by an apéro.

events.title: Confidential AI for Banking: Open Models, Frontier Labs and Secure Deployment
events.blurb: Executive breakfast on the trade-offs between frontier models, open models and confidential deployment for banks, weighing data protection, banking secrecy, outsourcing risk and governance.

events.title: Hack VS
events.blurb: A 24-hour hackathon on the Foire du Valais floor where around 50 students and professionals tackle real HR and wastewater-technology challenges set by Valais companies, coached by HES-SO mentors and pitching to a jury on stage.

events.title: Coffee & Prompt #005
events.blurb: Casual Saturday morning coworking session in Geneva for people building AI projects — work on your own thing, share what you are making and get feedback from the others in the room. Twelve places.

events.title: Robotics and AI Hackathon — The Gallery Zurich
events.blurb: A one-day build in a 20,000 m² robotics hall — 80 builder seats, teams of up to four, demos at 17:00.

events.title: Azure Zurich AI Agents Governance Night
events.blurb: In-person Azure user-group evening on running AI agents securely: agent identity in Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC and policies across Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry, plus enterprise agent governance.

events.title: Forum EPFL 2026
events.blurb: Switzerland's largest tech recruitment fair, with 188+ companies exhibiting at EPFL.

events.title: Networking: Trust by Design – Standards for Aligned AI Governance
events.blurb: Standards-focused networking event on aligned AI governance and the EU AI Act.

events.title: Webinaire : Baromètre IA relation client 2026 en Suisse
events.blurb: French-language webinar presenting the first Swiss survey of how AI is actually used in customer relations — which use cases are live today, what is holding adoption back, and what Swiss companies can take from the findings.

events.title: Dell Technologies Forum Zürich 2026
events.blurb: Full-day German-language conference for Swiss IT leaders on future-ready AI and infrastructure, drawing 700+ attendees across intelligent endpoints, modern infrastructure and AI skills.

events.title: Panoramai Summit Geneva 2026 – IA et nous, responsables
events.blurb: Full-day summit on responsible AI and governance, free in the morning.

events.title: SC70: Cybersécurité pragmatique & UX à l'ère des LLM
events.venue: Digicomp Academy Suisse Romande, Av. de la Gare 50
events.blurb: Two French-language talks in Lausanne: turning a technical vulnerability report into a strategic decision tool, and four paradigms — Vanilla, MCP, MCP Apps and WebMCP — for designing interfaces in the LLM era.

events.title: Votation 2032
events.blurb: A French-language role-play of a 2032 Geneva cantonal voting campaign, using generative AI to produce the campaign material — a hands-on look at what shifts in public debate when convincing content costs almost nothing but verification still does not.

events.title: AI Office Hours – Vol. 1
events.blurb: No slides and no fixed agenda — an open Zurich session where the room sets the topics, bringing whatever AI tools, questions and stuck problems they are actually working on.

events.title: Alpine Agentic Search
events.blurb: Four technical talks on how retrieval, vector search, reranking and generative models are changing for agent-driven workloads, including evaluation for multi-turn search agents, aimed at senior ML and infrastructure engineers.

events.title: Salon RH 2026
events.blurb: HR and recruitment trade fair with a growing AI-in-hiring track.

events.title: Zürich — 87th Fabric User Group
events.blurb: The Swiss Fabric user group’s monthly online session: Kristian’s "What’s New" round-up of the platform, then Zebra BI as guest on their Zebra AI solution. Recorded and published afterwards.

events.title: Advanced LLM Applications and Agentic Systems — Training at EPFL
events.cost: CHF 1,000 (10% off for EPFL alumni and SDSC partners)
events.blurb: One-day hands-on SDSC training on structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling and agentic workflows — and the evaluation and cost control needed to run them in production.

events.title: {Tech: Europe} Agentic AI Hack Zurich
events.blurb: A one-day agentic AI hackathon capped at 70 builders — teams form in the morning, mentors and free compute credits on hand through the day, live demos at 20:00 and awards at 20:45.

events.title: Build Your Own Assistant: Stop Drowning In Your Inbox
events.blurb: Three hours of hands-on building in Geneva: wire an agent into your inbox, calendar and Slack so it sorts what is urgent and drafts the replies.

events.title: Coffee & Prompt #006
events.blurb: Relaxed weekend-morning coworking in Geneva for builders, makers and the AI-curious — work on your own project, optionally show what you have made, and get feedback from the room.

events.title: Fabric Governance — Domains, Workspaces & Lineage
events.organiser: Data and AI for Intelligent Cloud
events.blurb: Zurich Microsoft data-platform group on governance patterns that scale rather than block: workspace design, domains and decentralised ownership, capacity planning, and lineage for compliance.

events.title: OWASP Switzerland — 25th Anniversary Edition
events.venue: ETH Zurich, Zurich Information Security and Privacy Center, FoodLab, Universitätstrasse 6
events.blurb: Anniversary edition with three talks — making AI a strategic partner in security (SIX), where well-meant phishing advice backfires (ETH Zurich), and using OWASP as one prioritisation lens from APIs through to agents (Microsoft) — then an apéro riche.

events.title: AWS Swiss User Group Geneva #29 — Digital Sovereignty in the Cloud
events.venue: AWS Geneva Office, Place de Hollande 2
events.blurb: Autumn meetup of the Geneva AWS user group, taking on digital sovereignty in the cloud — what it means for where data sits and who controls it.

events.title: IBM Bob Coding Watch Party Zürich
events.blurb: Hands-on hybrid session at IBM’s Zurich office on IBM Bob, an AI development assistant for building and modernising code, with beginner, intermediate and expert tracks.

events.title: ERH Physical AI Hackathon
events.blurb: Around 50 European engineers get 36 hours with robot arms, mobile platforms, sensors and compute on the DARE Campus, with on-site mentors and a closing pitch to founders, researchers and investors.

events.title: Smart Services Summit 2026
events.blurb: Summit on AI-enabled services and data-driven value, hosted by the Swiss data innovation community.

events.title: Build Your Own Assistant: Widen Your Reach
events.blurb: Build an agent that scans your industry and city for events worth your time and tells you why to go and who to meet, instead of trawling listings by hand.

events.title: People Analytics Switzerland Meetup | October 2026
events.blurb: Autumn session of the Swiss people-analytics community, sharing practice and fresh thinking on AI and analytics initiatives inside Swiss organisations. Places are tightly limited.

events.title: Same, But Better. No Mistakes. An Introduction to Agentic Legacy Modernization
events.blurb: Michael walks through an agent-ready approach to legacy modernisation — which established principles carry over to agentic software engineering, and what is still missing before a modernisation effort actually succeeds.

events.title: Ethische Führung im KI-Zeitalter: Wie gelingt verantwortungsvolle Innovation?
events.blurb: German-language keynote by Sebastian Rosengrün on the social dynamics of AI, then a panel with Christian Hugo Hoffmann and practitioners on what responsible AI leadership actually requires, followed by an apéro.

events.title: Google AI Live + Labs — Zurich
events.blurb: A day of Google Cloud keynotes and hands-on labs on putting AI agents into production, with four tracks to choose from: automating business processes, the technical foundations for scaling agents, a developer lab and a lab on grounding agents in your own data.

events.title: Our Minds Under Siege — An Evening with Bruno Giussani
events.venue: ETH AI Center, OAT S 15, Oerlikon
events.blurb: An evening on AI, information and trust: how machine-generated content is changing our ability to tell truth from manipulation, and what it takes to keep human judgement intact in a world shaped by algorithms.

events.title: F{AI}R Unconference 2026
events.blurb: Two days of AI talks, workshops and demos in Bern run as an unconference, with the programme built from sessions submitted by the people who turn up.

events.title: The Zurich AI Summit 2026 – Digital Trust
events.blurb: An evening for around 250 Swiss AI and business leaders, built around a panel on digital trust with speakers from Novartis, ABB, Nemetschek Group and Swiss Re, followed by networking.

events.title: Zurich Robotics Roundtable #5
events.blurb: Zurich’s quarterly gathering for people building in robotics and physical AI — newly funded robotics startups present, then a panel and open networking for around 250 founders, engineers and researchers.

events.title: AI Productivity User Group Conference @ Microsoft Switzerland
events.blurb: In-person conference on AI productivity tooling — Copilot Cowork, Azure AI integration, and AI-driven meeting workflows — with MVP speakers at Microsoft's Zurich Airport campus.

events.title: ArtTech Hack 2026
events.blurb: A three-day hackathon in Zurich for students and recent graduates from art, design and technology, with briefs in data, simulation and robotics — challenges revealed Friday, building Saturday, jury presentations Sunday.

events.title: Zentral Hack 2026
events.blurb: 24-hour hackathon for central Switzerland, bringing together students, business and the regional ICT community at HSLU Rotkreuz.

events.title: Build Your Own Assistant: Never Walk Into A Meeting Blind
events.blurb: Build an agent that briefs you on the person, the company and the purpose before every meeting, then drafts the follow-up the moment it ends.

events.title: Leading Data Conference Switzerland 2026
events.cost: 200 CHF (170 early bird) / 140 CHF members (110 early bird)
events.blurb: DAMA Switzerland's annual data leadership conference at IMD Lausanne, covering data modelling, data-as-an-asset workshops, and CDMP certification.

events.title: Swiss Data Space Forum 2026: Unlocking Data for AI
events.blurb: National forum on data governance and data spaces for AI, hosted at unlimitrust.

events.title: CAR16 : IA en entreprise avec AI Foundry et sécurité des MCP
events.venue: Tesla Store Genève, Rue de la Confédération 8
events.blurb: French-language Azure community evening in Geneva on enterprise AI with Azure AI Foundry, securing Model Context Protocol servers, and modern cloud architecture and automation with GitHub Copilot.

events.title: Conversation avec Bruno Giussani sur l'emprise et la souveraineté technologique
events.venue: HEG Bâtiment C Nexus Agora, Rue de la Tambourine 17
events.blurb: A French-language discussion with Swiss author and podcaster Bruno Giussani on resisting technological capture and European dependence on American digital infrastructure, drawing on his Manuel de résistance à l'emprise technologique.

events.title: Fabric & Power BI User Group Geneva 2026
events.blurb: Geneva user-group evening on Power BI and Microsoft Fabric — speaker sessions, customer use cases and product news, followed by an apéro.

events.title: The Great Data Heist: Trust, Power & Cyber Warfare
events.venue: Uptown Geneva, Rue de la Servette 2
events.blurb: Cybersecurity experts and hackers unpack how data breaches actually happen, with live hacking demos and an immersive escape game.

events.title: Spec-driven Development mit KI
events.venue: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule, Campus Rapperswil, Oberseestrasse 10
events.blurb: Two German-language talks on the OST Rapperswil campus: Java Champion Simon Martinelli on driving development from specifications with AI, and Michael Inden on why algorithms and data structures matter more, not less, once everyone can generate code — followed by networking.

events.title: AI Breakfast #55 Luzern
events.blurb: Next instalment of the Lucerne breakfast series on AI in business; topic to be announced.

events.title: BaselHack 2026
events.blurb: Free 48-hour hackathon for the Basel region with open and sponsored challenges, for developers, designers and anyone wanting to turn an idea into a working prototype.

events.title: Ticino Data Conference 2026
events.venue: Acer EMEA Regional Headquarters, Via della Posta 28
events.blurb: Free one-day community summit in Ticino with three tracks on Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, AI-assisted tooling and data governance, in English and Italian.

events.title: Build Your Own Assistant: What Did I Even Get Done This Week?
events.blurb: Build an agent that produces daily and weekly recaps of your own or your team's work, alongside the industry and regulatory news that actually affects you.

events.title: AI and Responsible Business Conduct
events.organiser: SECO / Federal Department of Foreign Affairs
events.blurb: A plenary session at the Swiss Forum on Business and Human Rights on applying the UN Guiding Principles and OECD Guidelines to AI systems in practice, with UN representatives, technology companies and civil society. Interpretation in German, French and English.

events.title: Destination AI – Verpasse den Zug nicht!
events.blurb: Full-day German-language AI conference for the Swiss partner and reseller ecosystem, with a keynote by futurist Gerd Leonhard, vendor breakout sessions and business meetings.

events.title: Snowflake Forum Zurich 2026
events.venue: The Circle Convention Center, The Circle 27
events.blurb: Free data-platform conference bringing together Swiss data teams and partners.

events.title: HerImpact 2026: Who Decides — You or AI?
events.blurb: Talks and a panel on who stays accountable when AI shapes an organisational decision — who can question it, correct it or stop it — drawing on current Swiss and Japanese research and real cases, closing with questions the group puts forward for the 2027 Geneva summit.

events.title: Swiss AI Safety Days 2026
events.blurb: Weekend conference on AI safety research, governance, and careers.

events.title: Build Your Own Assistant: Time to Stop AI Slop
events.blurb: A session on getting an assistant to write in your own voice rather than generic model output, then turning the week's news into a post and a newsletter worth reading.

events.title: UNIGE – Recherche documentaire et IA
events.blurb: University of Geneva workshop on using AI tools for academic research.

events.title: Agentic Trio
events.blurb: INNOQ’s Fabian Walther reframes Teresa Torres’ Product Trio as an "Agentic Trio", arguing that AI should change how software teams split responsibility — not just how fast they ship.

events.title: C4DT Conference on AI Sovereignty: Charting Switzerland’s Path
events.blurb: A full day on how Switzerland builds strategic independence in AI between US and Chinese dominance — lessons from other middle powers, Swiss research including the Apertus foundation model, industry deployment realities, and concrete recommendations for national strategy.

events.title: Navigating Data Protection and Transfer Impact Assessments for AI Startups
events.blurb: Breakfast session with lawyers from Wenger Vieli on when a Transfer Impact Assessment is actually required for cross-border data transfers, and how to keep them manageable as an AI company.

events.title: DevOps for Fabric — Git & Deployment Pipelines
events.organiser: Data and AI for Intelligent Cloud
events.blurb: Bringing proper CI/CD to Microsoft Fabric: Git integration, deployment pipelines, variable libraries and sensitivity labels for enterprise-ready BI.

events.title: Kickstart AI Workflows with Databricks
events.organiser: Swiss Data & AI Group (Databricks User Group)
events.blurb: Hybrid Databricks user-group evening in Zurich on automating data work with AI-enabled workflows, including a session on Databricks Apps and Lakebase applied to clinical cancer research cohorts.

events.title: AI Startup Center Community Meetup — November Edition
events.blurb: A deliberately informal morning meetup over coffee for the centre’s AI startups and corporate partners — no agenda and no presentations, just conversations about partnerships, where AI is heading and what is actually hard right now.

events.title: Swiss Robotics Day 2026
events.organiser: ETH Zurich RobotX / Swiss Robotics Association
events.blurb: The national robotics meeting point: keynotes, panels and workshops alongside an exhibition floor with 60+ exhibitors and live demos, bringing together labs, industry, policymakers and spin-offs.

events.title: Swiss AI Summit 2026
events.blurb: Full-day summit on enterprise AI strategy with executive roundtables.

events.title: AI in Production: Introduction to MLOps — Training at EPFL
events.cost: CHF 1,000 (10% off for EPFL alumni and SDSC partners)
events.blurb: One-day SDSC training on designing, deploying and operating ML systems at scale — version control, CI/CD, experiment tracking, monitoring, drift detection and automated retraining. Registration closes 24 September.

events.title: Agentic Engineering Days Zurich 2026
events.blurb: A one-day engineering conference on AI coding and agent systems: 38+ sessions across four tracks — using AI tools, building AI-powered systems, sponsor spotlights and hands-on workshops — with speakers from OpenAI, Hugging Face, NVIDIA, Google and AWS.

events.title: AI Breakfast #56 Luzern
events.blurb: November edition of the Lucerne breakfast series on AI in business; topic to be announced.

events.title: The Geneva AI Conference 2026
events.blurb: Evening conference on enterprise AI strategy and ROI with an IBM/SAP panel.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Onsite Hackathon Zurich
events.blurb: The on-site leg of the national Apertus hackathon: build on the open Apertus 8B model, strengthen its multilingual abilities and ship applications for private- and public-sector problems, with everything released as Open Commons.

events.title: AI Insights for Chief Executives
events.venue: Swiss AI Tower, ETH Zürich, Andreasstrasse 5
events.blurb: Executive workshop for CEOs, CFOs, CDOs and CTOs on turning data and AI into measurable business value, with case studies from EKZ, Merck and Richemont. Limited seats.

events.title: Databricks Data + AI World Tour Zurich 2026
events.blurb: Databricks' flagship Swiss event on the Lakehouse platform and Unity Catalog.

events.title: IBM Bob Coding Watch Party Zürich — Final Edition
events.blurb: The closing session of IBM's 2026 hybrid series on IBM Bob, its AI development assistant — coding live alongside other European cities, with beginner, intermediate and expert tracks covering everything from first idea to modernising legacy applications.

events.title: Fabric Year in Review 2026 — Highlights & Outlook
events.organiser: Data and AI for Intelligent Cloud
events.blurb: Year-end session from the Zurich Microsoft data-platform group on what actually shipped in Fabric during 2026 and what is worth planning for next.

events.title: The Night of Data Talents: Swiss Edition
events.blurb: Swiss data startups pitch to an investor panel with community voting, capping the year for the Suisse Romande data scene.
